decisions.decision: Keep registration and the entire undeployed account feature gated until provider, operational, and legal prerequisites are complete.
decisions.rationale: The live Worker currently has no account route or secrets and the privacy notice is a draft.

decisions.decision: Use a durable dual Windows package transition starting at 1.21.3.
decisions.rationale: Old clients reject new files; the legacy package upgrades the updater first, then the same-version v2 package completes the install.

decisions.decision: Preserve private identity continuity with client-side encrypted recovery wraps rather than uploading a plaintext/extractable key.
decisions.rationale: The server must not receive the raw signing key; password and high-entropy recovery wraps cover normal switching and password-reset recovery.

decisions.decision: Existing nonextractable identities require a signed one-time transition to a new recoverable identity.
decisions.rationale: WebCrypto correctly prevents export of the installed key, so bypassing that property is neither possible nor safe.
